resources.string: Remaps selected remote buttons. No screen content, text or network access. Enable only to use your configured mappings.

Configure buttons from Shield Controller → Settings → TV maintenance. Enable the service below. Power, volume and directional navigation are never remapped. Some firmware intercepts Home or special buttons before this service.
Remove all mappings and restore normal button handling?
Service disconnected: enable it in Accessibility

If the TV reports that no app can handle the action, return to Shield Controller in your browser, update this companion, then use Enable remote service (ADB). Confirm there to activate only this service. You can also navigate manually through Settings → Device Preferences → Accessibility.
Open Device Preferences → Accessibility → Shield Controller Remote.
